recognize_zh: 這是折線圖而非形態學：縱軸為血中 EBV PCR 定量（gEq/mL），病毒量從 10 月底近零逐步升到約 66,000，類固醇治療後短暫下降，隨後再升至約 114,000；第一劑 rituximab（抗 CD20）後迅速降到約 11,800，說明 B 細胞內 EBV 複製對清除 B 細胞的治療有反應。
features: Line graph of quantitative EBV PCR (gEq/mL) versus date from late October to late December 2021
Gradual rise from near zero to about 12,000 (early November) and about 66,000 (late November)
Arrow marking steroid therapy near the first peak, followed by a transient fall to about 24,000
Rebound to about 91,000, 100,000 and a peak of about 114,000 in mid-December
Arrow marking the first rituximab dose at the peak, followed by a sharp fall to about 11,800
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic line graph showing serial quantitative EBV DNA PCR results in blood after allogeneic stem cell transplantation. Viral load rose progressively from near zero to approximately 66,000 gEq/mL, fell transiently to about 24,000 gEq/mL after steroid therapy for GVHD, then rebounded to a peak of approximately 114,000 gEq/mL. After the first dose of rituximab, the viral load fell abruptly to approximately 11,800 gEq/mL. The graph illustrates uncontrolled post-transplant EBV reactivation with a prompt virologic response to pre-emptive anti-CD20 therapy, which should be interpreted alongside clinical and histologic assessment for post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: PTLD requires tissue showing a lymphoproliferation (mass lesion or destructive infiltrate with EBER-positive cells), whereas viremia alone indicates reactivation without proving PTLD.
A single aberrant value would not form a consistent trend, whereas serial concordant rises and a treatment-linked fall support true viral kinetics.
